import socket, sys, time

HOST, PORT = 'polly.chal.csaw.io', 5000

class Conn:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s = socket.create_connection((HOST, PORT), timeout=15)
        self.s.settimeout(5)
        self.buf = b''
    def read_until(self, marker, timeout=8):
        end = time.time() + timeout
        while marker not in self.buf:
            if time.time() > end:
                raise TimeoutError(self.buf)
            try:
                d = self.s.recv(65536)
            except socket.timeout:
                continue
            if not d:
                raise EOFError(self.buf)
            self.buf += d
        i = self.buf.index(marker) + len(marker)
        out, self.buf = self.buf[:i], self.buf[i:]
        return out
    def send(self, line):
        self.s.sendall(line + b'\n')

c = Conn()
banner = c.read_until(b'which seed modifier would you like to use?\n', 15)
print('BANNER:', banner.decode(errors='replace'))

xs = [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,256,1<<20,1<<24,1<<32,1<<40,1<<48,1<<56,1<<63,(1<<64)-1, 3, 7]
for x in xs:
    c.send(str(x).encode())
    c.read_until(b'enter a string to be encrypted: ', 10)
    c.send(b'A'*8)
    r = c.read_until(b'which seed modifier would you like to use?\n', 10)
    print('x=%d ->' % x, r.decode(errors='replace').strip())
c.s.close()

        raise EOFError

    if not line.endswith(b"\n"):
        while line and not line.endswith(b"\n"):
            line = sys.stdin.buffer.readline(max_bytes + 3)
        return None

    value = line[:-1]
    if value.endswith(b"\r"):
        value = value[:-1]

    if len(value) > max_bytes:

    return value


def transform(state, num):

    if num % 2 == 0:
    
        state ^= (state << shifts[0]) & MASK64
        state ^= state >> shifts[1]
        state ^= (state << shifts[2]) & MASK64
        state ^= state >> shifts[3]

        state ^= (state << shifts[1])& MASK64
        state ^= (state >> shifts[2]) 
        state ^= (state << shifts[3]) & MASK64
        
    return state & MASK64


def transformation(operator, state):
    result = 0

    for bit in range(64):
        if state & (1 << bit):
            result ^= operator[bit]

    return result & MASK64


def square_operator(operator):
    return [
        transformation(operator, column)
        for column in operator
    ]

    first_jump = [
        transform(1 << bit,  num)
        for bit in range(64)
    ]

    jumps = [first_jump]
